summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) using the shared venv's Python. Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only. One addition beyond the spec: a guard raises SHACLPathError for any non-Node input before graph lookups, so None cannot act as a wildcard.
